valuation.method: Forward Adjusted EPS x P/E (FY2027E EPS viewed at the 12-month target date). RELX PLC NYSE ADR ratio is 1:1 with LSE ordinary shares; GBP figures converted to USD at the 2026-11-13 GBP/USD close of 1.3217.

bear.driver: Slower Legal/Risk AI monetization and macro headwinds compress growth to ~5% and multiple to 17.0x.
bear.assumption: FY2027E Adjusted EPS £1.48 ($1.96 at 1.3217 GBP/USD) at 17.0x P/E

base.driver: Sustained ~7% underlying revenue growth, 35.5%+ operating margin, and £2.25B share buyback execution.
base.assumption: FY2027E Adjusted EPS £1.55 ($2.05 at 1.3217 GBP/USD) at 22.0x P/E

bull.driver: Accelerated Lexis+ AI adoption in Legal (+10% H1 2026) and Risk (+8%) drives operating leverage and re-rating.
bull.assumption: FY2027E Adjusted EPS £1.62 ($2.14 at 1.3217 GBP/USD) at 25.0x P/E

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E EPS of $2.05 (£1.55 at 1.3217 GBP/USD), the $40.51 close implies 19.8x forward P/E.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $2.05 (5.1 pp of price return).
valuation.watch_metric: Underlying revenue growth in Legal (+10% in H1 2026) and Risk (+8% in H1 2026), plus adjusted operating margin (35.5% in H1 2026).
valuation.next_disclosure: FY 2026 full-year results expected on February 18, 2027.

analyst_notes: Individual named analyst records with dated US-listing targets were unavailable; firm-level coverage on LSE: REL (converted at 1.3217 GBP/USD) shows Buy/Overweight ratings from JPMorgan (5,070p), UBS (3,780p), Barclays (3,400p), and Goldman Sachs (3,100p), alongside Hold/Neutral ratings from Citigroup (3,125p) and Morgan Stanley (2,990p) reiterated in Oct-Nov 2026. Because named analyst histories could not be verified, events are left empty and coverage is marked unavailable.
